I'm a bioinformatician in the [Division of Neurosurgery](https://health.uct.ac.za/neurosurgery) at the University of Cape Town for the [African Brain Child Initiative](https://africanbrainchild.com/). We are affiliated to the [Neuroscience Institute](https://neuroscience.uct.ac.za/). I assist our team with quantitative research on paediatric central nervous system conditions including tuberculous meningitis, traumatic brain injury, and brain tumour classification. I am primarily based in the Institute for Child Health at the [Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital](https://www.childrenshospitaltrust.org.za/the-hospital/).
